utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few sturdy boxes, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and a few sturdy boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair point — can you confirm the pickup time and the drop-off place first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — once I have the pickup time and drop-off address, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I think I heard something about it, but I might’ve missed the details. What do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too, but it’s for fixing up the shared stuff around the block. If you want, I can check with the others and get the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great — I probably missed the announcement. Let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping folks in the loop. I’ll tell a few neighbors while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep sharing updates, and you can let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a little late, but I can still help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Dane — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll sort through the donated tools and pull out anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send out the invite and rally folks to bring tools and a few supplies. Let’s meet at the community shed Saturday morning and make a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning at the community shed works for me. Send the invite, and I’ll bring my checklist so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we starting the repair drive today, or do you still need help getting things organized?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re starting today — I could use a hand getting everything organized first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what do you want me to sort first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks for the repair drive—just tell me what you need and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you spread the word that we need people at the east lot by 9 a.m. on Saturday? If anyone can bring a pickup or tools, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know: east lot by 9 a.m. Saturday, and pickups or tools would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in — what’s the plan for the repair drive, and how can I help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — thank you, Mara. I’m putting together a simple sign-up sheet for tools, skills, and time slots, and I’d love for you to help me collect a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help gather a few more volunteers and point them to the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what Bo’s short on, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m short on tape and a couple of box cutters, I think.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll mark down tape and a couple box cutters for Bo.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely — folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you need the details, I can pass along what I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. If you hear where they still need help, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know where they still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the details before we do anything—what’s the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s a neighborhood repair drive to help fix up a few homes, and I just need a hand confirming the schedule and any supplies we should bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll confirm the schedule and make a quick list of supplies before we go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just a quick hand sorting what’s broken and what still works, so we can load the right stuff for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help sort through it and separate the broken stuff from the working pieces. Point me to the pile and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive—just tell me what time and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome — let’s meet at 10 this Saturday by the community center. I’ll send the details so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — 10 this Saturday by the community center works for me. I’ll spread the word once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you could just help spread the word and bring any tools you can spare, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and see what tools I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll probably swing by the repair drive later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — if you need a hand, I’ve got a few tools you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that if I run into anything tricky.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’ve got the repair drive notes ready and I’m keeping everything organized. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the locations first so we can keep the list tidy. Which addresses are on the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: So far I have 12 Maple Street, 8 Birch Avenue, and 41 Pine Lane on the list. If you’ve got any more, I’ll add them in order.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want the exact time, pickup spot, and what kind of repairs we’re expecting first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact time, pickup spot, and repair details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — once you’ve got those details, send them over and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on — I’m just checking the details before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just wanted to make sure it wasn’t off already.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — let’s keep it simple and set a clear plan for the repair drive. What’s the first step you want me to take?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’d start by making a quick list of the biggest repairs and who can help with each one. Then I can swing by late and fill in any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll make the list and note who can help with each repair. I’ll have it ready for you when you swing by late.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized—do you know what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need to sort the donated tools and check what fasteners are missing. I can keep an eye on the supplies if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I'll help sort the tools and see what fasteners we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m sorry, Mara, I’ve been a bit scattered lately, but I’m happy to help if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — thanks for that. I’ll let you know what needs doing, and we can take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Mara — one step at a time is about all I can manage these days. Just point me where to start, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to arrange pickup or drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay—let’s prioritize the loose front-step railing first. Send me the timing and drop-off spot when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—I’ll check the school schedule and send you the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have them.
